title: Blood Into Milk
hook: Rumi once stopped writing his great poem, for a long time.

segments.en: For a while, this Masnavi was delayed.

segments.fa: مهلتی بایست تا خون شیر شد
segments.en: Time was needed, for blood to turn to milk.

tafsir: This is the first line of the Masnavi's second book.
The poem had paused, and Rumi begins again.
The old belief was that a mother's milk is made from her blood.
One reading: pain needs time before it can feed anyone.
This week in our serial, the Masnavi begins.

outro.say: Shams and Rumi, the serial, is on our page. Follow The Guest House.
